typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BatchId as integer (),
	CntMember as integer (),
	ExtractFileName as string (),
	ExtractFilePath as string (),
	FailureFrom as string (),
	FailureTo as string (),
	FileNameSuffix as string (),
	gv_BatchDate as timestamp (),
	gv_SQLCatalog as string (),
	gv_SQLDataSource as string (),
	gv_SQLPassword as string (),
	gv_SQLProvider as string (),
	gv_SQLUserName as string (),
	SmtpServer as string (),
	SuccessCCTo as string (),
	SuccessFrom as string (),
	SuccessTo as string ()
}

source(output(
		RECORD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT RECORD FROM DOWNGRADE.DOWNGRADE WHERE BATCHID = ? ORDER BY HCID DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Column_0 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = RECORD)) ~> FlatFileDestination
